name: ai-enabler-metrics
displayName: AI Enabler Metrics — AI usage and delivery flow
description: Measures how a team uses AI and how it delivers. Passive, opt-in hooks capture usage metrics: human interaction, AI working time versus human waiting and thinking time, output, and token cost in USD per session, user, ticket, skill and model (Anthropic or Amazon Bedrock prices). Delivery-flow skills measure pull request size, review waiting time, rework and Jira cycle time with bundled scripts, reading GitHub through the GitHub CLI. A delivery metric becomes a KPI only when the team sets a target for it; usage figures are context and never take targets. Reports are self-contained HTML with charts, plus Markdown, JSON and CSV, and a report of skills and agents that have gone unused.
